scientific_intent.scientific_task: Apply bias addition followed by tanh-approximate GELU in place.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Round x+bias toFloat16, promote toFloat32 for0.5*x*(1+tanh(sqrt(2/pi)*(x+0.044715*x^3))), round output toFloat16.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Dense batch4 x sequence128 x hidden1024 tensor; independent featurewise activation.
invariants: Zero maps to zero after bias application.
Positive/negative saturation follows the approximate GELU formula, not ReLU clipping.
accuracy_requirements: All half outputs compared after losslessFloat32 widening, absolute1e-3, with required half-add rounding retained.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float16 rounding before nonlinear Float32 activation is essential; widening operands before addition changes the target.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Base andvec2 cases, hidden1024,batch4,sequence128,ten repeats; other hidden dimensions unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Bias/activation primitive; source hidden_dim/seq_len comments support neural tensor role, not a specific domain-science model.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Approximate tanh GELU, not an exact-erf GELU or full neural network.
